name: Ticker Resolution and Holdings Enrichment Pipeline
description: BD feed provides ticker=None for ~80% of non-Opal securities. Build a ticker resolution table (asset_name -> ticker), enrich holdings_lots at build time (script 03 join), backfill bd-securities name_aliases, and extend detect_new_securities for ongoing coverage. Fixes the systemic 'Other' misclassification caused by ETFClassifier Layer 1 failure on tickerless holdings.
phase: Phase 0: CTO approved. Immediate partial fix deployed (ETFClassifier asset_name_raw indexing, commit 0c0fdb28). COO task order decomposition pending.
